title: The Chief Works of Benedict de Spinoza, Vol. 1 (Improvement of the Understanding; Ethics; Correspondence)
author: Baruch Spinoza
description: R. H. M. Elwes’s English edition brings together Spinoza’s Improvement of the Understanding, the five parts of the Ethics and selected correspondence.
editionNote: 1901 edition. London: Universal Classics Library / Bohn (orig. 1883). Edition credit: R.H.M. Elwes (fl.1883).
rights: Public-domain historical edition. Source credit and notices are retained.
